items.title: Chancellor outlines devolution plans in first budget
items.summary: According to The Guardian, the budget details plans to devolve income tax receipts and business rates to mayors, though questions remain over areas excluded from the proposals.

items.title: Retail and hospitality businesses react to business rates and minimum wage measures in Chancellor John Healey's first budget
items.summary: According to The Guardian, high street operators and hospitality firms have given a mixed response to the Chancellor's budget, welcoming targeted business rates relief while warning that ongoing labour costs and tax pressures remain heavy.

items.title: Grim CTE numbers raise the stakes for UK sport's insurers
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, a new US study estimating high CTE prevalence among professional football players arrives as UK insurers face major litigation involving former rugby players.

items.title: JAB completes Utmost deal as overseas capital reshapes UK pension market
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, miami-based JAB Insurance has closed its acquisition of Utmost Life and Pensions, entering the UK bulk purchase annuity market as part of a wider wave of overseas consolidation.

items.title: US congressional investigation highlights gaps in federal response to global cyber scams
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, a Joint Economic Committee report finds that US government efforts against international scam compounds remain fragmented, with limited data on asset recovery.

items.title: Guardian readers share personal financial pressures following Budget 2026
items.summary: According to The Guardian, readers across the UK, from young workers to pensioners, detail how recent tax, housing and energy announcements impact their household budgets.
